question:
Please list the reference names of the drivers who are eliminated in the first period in race number 20.
Benchmark knowledge evidence: driver reference name refers to driverRef; first qualifying period refers to q1; drivers who are eliminated in the first qualifying period refers to 5 drivers with MAX(q1); race number refers to raceId;

auxiliary_raw_evidence_draft.base_sql:
SELECT
  d.XCL_038 AS reference_name
FROM results r
JOIN drivers d ON r.XCL_075 = d.XCL_034
JOIN status s ON r.XCL_090 = s.XCL_093
WHERE
  r.XCL_074 = 20
  AND r.XCL_077 = 1
  AND s.XCL_094 = 'Eliminated'

base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
SELECT d.XCL_035
FROM qualifying q
JOIN drivers d ON q.XCL_058 = d.XCL_034
WHERE q.XCL_057 = 20
  AND q.XCL_062 IN (
    SELECT XCL_062 FROM qualifying WHERE XCL_057 = 20 ORDER BY XCL_062 DESC LIMIT 5
  )
